@sheavly/source: An export condition in every package's `exports` (the source build), not an import specifier.
issueType: A `gh --json` field (GitHub's API), not code in this repo.
subIssues: A `gh --json` field (GitHub's API), not code in this repo.
subIssuesSummary: A `gh --json` field (GitHub's API), not code in this repo.
blockedBy: A `gh --json` field (GitHub's API), not code in this repo.
isDraft: A `gh --json` field (GitHub's API), not code in this repo.
baseRefName: A `gh --json` field (GitHub's API), not code in this repo.
reviewDecision: A `gh --json` field (GitHub's API), not code in this repo.
statusCheckRollup: A `gh --json` field (GitHub's API), not code in this repo.
closingIssuesReferences: A `gh --json` field (GitHub's API), not code in this repo.
needsRebase: A `gh stack view --json` field (the gh-stack extension), not code in this repo.
index.json: A stored conversation's file under ~/.sheavly, named in the debugging guide; data on the user's disk, not a file in this repo.
shell.json: A stored conversation's working-root file under ~/.sheavly, named in the debugging guide; data on the user's disk, not a file in this repo.
queue.json: A stored conversation's queued lines under ~/.sheavly, named in the debugging guide; data on the user's disk, not a file in this repo.
permissions/<key>.json: A command-approval file under ~/.sheavly, named in the debugging guide; data on the user's disk, not a file in this repo.
credentials.json: The secret store under ~/.sheavly, named in the debugging guide only to say never to read it; data on the user's disk, not a file in this repo.
workbook/runs/<id>/: A workbook run folder, written when a run is made and kept out of git; named in the debugging guide.
transcript.txt: A file in a workbook run folder, written when a run is made and kept out of git; named in the debugging guide.
result.json: A file in a workbook run folder, written when a run finishes and kept out of git; named in the guides.
.git/cursor-docs-nudged.json: The docs nudge's record inside a clone's .git folder, written by the stop hook; not a tracked file.
